SIGGRAPH Papers 2000–2026

SIGGRAPH Papers

Every technical paper from SIGGRAPH (2000–2026) and SIGGRAPH Asia (2008–2025): the journal track in ACM Transactions on Graphics and, since 2022, the conference track. Titles link to the ACM Digital Library; free copies are linked where one exists.

| |
| |
|

In Stats, authors are counted by the name as printed, so two people who share a name count as one, and one person whose name appears in two spellings counts twice. Institutions come from OpenAlex's affiliation records, which cover 97% of the papers; a paper counts once for each institution among its authors.

Titles, authors and DOIs come from the metadata ACM registers with Crossref for each paper, cross-checked against OpenAlex. “ACM PDF” is ACM's own copy; “free PDF” is a copy elsewhere (arXiv or a university repository) that OpenAlex knows about, found for about a quarter of the papers.
